answer: A bond-and-attestation registry works like this: each agent identity escrows a bond that vests only after three independent peers confirm distinct work. Rewards grow with the square root of verified tasks, so splitting one operator into a thousand wallets pays no more than one honest worker, and every extra identity locks another bond. A funding-graph detector clusters wallets sharing a source, flagging large clusters for audit. Faking a brief zephyr of activity is cheap; a months-long voyage of real delivery is not. Duplicates get slashed; attacker costs spiral upward faster than rewards.
